verses.text: These are the words of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Mount Sinai.
Moses called all the Israelites together and said to them: You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to his whole land.
You saw the great troubles, the miraculous signs, and the great wonders.
But to this day the LORD has not given you a heart that understands, eyes that see, or ears that hear.
For forty years I led you through the desert. During that time your clothes did not wear out, and your sandals did not wear out on your feet.
You did not eat bread or drink wine or other strong drink. He did this so that you would know that he is the LORD your God.
When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to fight us, but we defeated them.
We took their land and gave it as a share to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to half the tribe of Manasseh.
So carefully obey the words of this covenant, so that you will succeed in everything you do.
Today all of you are standing in the presence of the LORD your God: your leaders and your tribes, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,
together with your children and wives, and the foreigners living in your camps who cut your wood and carry your water.
You are standing here to enter into a covenant with the LORD your God, a covenant he is making with you today and sealing with a promise.
Today he is making you his people, and he will be your God, just as he promised you and as he promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
I am not making this covenant, with its promise, only with you
who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God. I am also making it with those who are not here with us today.
You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the nations on our way here.
You saw their disgusting things and their idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

Make sure there is no man or woman, family or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that grows bitter poison.

When such a person hears the words of this curse, they may bless themselves in their heart and think, "I will be safe, even if I keep going my own stubborn way." This will bring disaster on the watered land and the dry land alike.

The LORD will never be willing to forgive them. His anger and jealousy will burn against that person like smoke. All the curses written in this book will fall on them, and the LORD will wipe out their name from under heaven.
The LORD will single them out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
Your children who come after you, and foreigners who come from far-away lands, will see the disasters that have struck the land and the diseases the LORD has sent on it.

The whole land will be burning sulphur and salt. Nothing will be planted, nothing will grow, and not even weeds will come up. It will be like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD destroyed in his fierce anger.
All the nations will ask, "Why has the LORD done this to this land? Why is he so terribly angry?"
And the answer will be: "It is because these people abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their ancestors, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.
They went and worshipped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods the LORD had not given them.
That is why the LORD's anger burned against this land, and he brought on it all the curses written in this book.
In great anger and fury the LORD pulled them up out of their land and threw them into another land, where they are today."
The secret things belong to the LORD our God. But the things he has shown us belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may obey all the words of this law.
